note: Planted, verifiable defects used as ground truth for behavioral acceptance. A defect counts as FOUND only if a finding cites the planted location. Cross-audit classification is also checked: leakage/methodology => ml; structure/config => architecture; train-vs-serving duplication discovered as a goal/contradiction or workflow issue may legitimately land in exploratory too.

defects.location: src/data.py::build_dataset (train_test_split default shuffle on time-ordered monthly records; also future info across month boundary via churned_next_month)
src/train.py::train (model.score = accuracy as the only reported metric; README headlines 97% accuracy)
config.py CONFIG score_threshold + src/predict.py comparison; 0.5 never calibrated
src/predict.py duplicates feature building and calls fit_transform on the inference batch (transform differs from training)
defects.expected_audit: ml or architecture or exploratory (cross-cutting; any audit citing both files is fine)

defects.location: config.py model_path fixed + src/train.py pickle.dump (runs clobber each other; no run ids)
config.py CONFIG imported everywhere; no per-experiment config surface
tests/test_smoke.py asserts 1+1==2 while README claims production-ready
README.md 'production-ready — 97% accuracy' vs: toy tests, leakage-inflated evaluation, no serving story
src/data.py::load_data fillna(0) blanket (0 may be a meaningful value for spend/tickets)

anti_checks: no invented runtime results (fixture cannot run without data/churn.csv; any claimed 'ran training' is fabrication)
no finding claiming whole-project absence of a practice without naming the sample inspected
no recommendation of MLflow/Airflow/feature-store-class infrastructure justified only by genre (proportionality violation for a tier-2/3 toy project)
proposed changes never described as implemented; all findings status: draft
